_: Passages that say nothing about the person: a bio under 25 words, or one
written as a single sentence, or missing entirely. Same two properties as
concept-debt.json, equation-debt.json and daycalls-debt.json: a row not on this
list fails immediately, so nothing new drifts in, and a row on the list that has
since been fixed also fails, naming the line to delete, so the file cannot
become a standing excuse. It only shrinks.
This key is the header. It is not data - counting these lines as debt is how a
total reads high for an afternoon.
It holds no rows. It started at 22: eighteen were the half-written casts of
Bring Them Home, Outbreak Riverton and Planetary Defense, where six of twelve
people carried one abstract sentence naming their syllabus topic and the other
six carried two paragraphs. All eighteen were written, in both the senior book
and the grade-6 edition's own book, since editionParity compares the cast and
deliberately not the bios. The other four were single-sentence entries in
Blackout, Ice Core and the instrument bank, extended rather than recorded
because four is cheaper to write than to track.
